programme: Chapman and Balakrishnan (1964), beams A1-A6: full-connection anchor (tabulated elastic deflections from Balakrishnan (1963) PhD thesis)
role: full-connection anchor (not a partial-connection specimen; excluded from the partial-connection statistics)
citations: Chapman, J.C. and Balakrishnan, S. (1964). Experiments on composite beams. The Structural Engineer 42(11), 369-383.

Balakrishnan, S.M. (1963). The behaviour of composite steel and concrete beams with welded stud shear connectors. PhD thesis, Imperial College, University of London (Spiral handle 10044/1/13358, open access).
sources_note: Values transcribed from the verified literature entry (orchestrator scratchpad lit_partial.json, 'verified' entry for Chapman and Balakrishnan), which checked every number against the rendered thesis and paper page images. No new digitising. Page images are kept outside the repository.
geometry_source: data/experimental/literature_tests.csv rows CB-A1-40T ... CB-A6-40T (span 216 in, slab 48 x 6 in, 12 x 6 in BSB idealised as d 12, b_f 6, t_f 0.66, t_w 0.42 in; cylinder f'c and flange F_y per beam)

loading.pattern: central point load W, simply supported span 18 ft = 216 in; jack load on a 9 x 7.5 x 1.5 in plate on plywood (thesis p. 67); point load spread over 9 in in the thesis calculation (thesis p. 138)

studs.type: 3/4 in x 4 in headed studs welded in pairs 3 in apart transversely (thesis p. 66)
studs.layout_source: paper Table 1 (p. 371) number and spacing in pairs; uniform spacing symmetric about mid-span assumed; at least one pair lies outside the span in every beam (thesis p. 133; A6: 16 pairs at 14.88 in = 223 in over the 216 in span)

thesis_p138_W5tons.source: Balakrishnan (1963) thesis p. 138 (PDF p. 145), Section 4.1: mid-span deflection at W = 5 tons, values in in x 1e-4; delta_bending, delta_shear and delta_total are the full-interaction calculation (per-beam E_c; shear with E_s 13,400 tsi, E_c 4.5e6 psi), delta_expt the mean of four readings

thesis_p143_W20tons.source: Balakrishnan (1963) thesis p. 143 (PDF p. 150), Section 4.2: mid-span deflection at W = 20 tons, in x 1e-3; partial-interaction theory bending, partial-interaction total, experiment; full-interaction theory bending 250 and total 280 (shear 30) for all six beams

first_end_slip_source: thesis Figs. 134-135 (PDF pp. 345-346); A1 no slip
slab_reinforcement: A1: 5/8 in bars, longitudinal at 5 in top and bottom; A2-A6: longitudinal 5/16 in at 12 in top and bottom (thesis p. 66)
caveats: chemical bond not prevented; the thesis attributes the near-full-interaction elastic response to bond still being effective (p. 143)
by the authors' push-out basis A6 is a 100 per cent design and A1-A5 are over-connected; these beams anchor the full-connection end only
slab carries about 32 % of the vertical shear (paper p. 376); the thesis shear term reflects that
